methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched per vendor on 2026-06-18: proof.com/pricing, bluenotary.us/pricing and ?tab=business, onenotary.com/pricing-new and /new-individuals-pricing, signix.com/notary-software-pricing and /digital-signature-pricing, notarylive.com/pricing (which DOES publish self-serve plans, contrary to the draft), and stavvy.com (no public pricing page). docverify.com is effectively dead — the official domain returns an expired-certificate error — so DocVerify e-sign prices rest ONLY on third-party aggregators (Verdocs/Capterra/G2) and could not be confirmed on a live official page; they are flagged accordingly. Compliance pages were fetched separately: proof.com/product/notarize (SOC 2, IAL2/Kantara, MISMO, WCAG AA, WebTrust; HIPAA/GDPR not stated), bluenotary.us homepage (HIPAA + SOC 2 Type 2 + MISMO badges), onenotary.com/compliance (SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001:2022 + MISMO; HIPAA not stated), signix.com/digital-signature-legality-and-compliance (HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001, FIPS 140-2 explicitly stated), stavvy.com (SOC 2 Type 2 + MISMO). Telephony fields (minutes/calls/overage) are null throughout — this is software, not telephony. Quote-only/enterprise tiers carry monthlyUsd=null. Per-notarization fees are captured in plan notes.

vendors.name: Proof (formerly Notarize)
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from proof.com/pricing on 2026-06-18; compliance from proof.com/product/notarize (SOC 2, IAL2 via Kantara, MISMO, WCAG AA, WebTrust audited explicitly listed; HIPAA and GDPR not stated). No flat monthly subscription is published — Business Pro and Title Pro are pay-per-transaction; Premium/Enterprise are annual/custom-quote. CORRECTION: the draft inverted the Business Pro Notarize fee — the official page shows $25 per notarization meeting via the Notarize Network (standard rate, one seal/one signer); $10 is the additional-seal fee, not a meeting fee. The claimed '$25 in-house' rate is not supported by the page.

plans.name: Business Pro
plans.notes: No flat monthly fee, no setup cost, no monthly minimum — pay-per-transaction. Notarize: $25 per notarization meeting via the Notarize Network (covers one notary seal, one signer); $10 per additional seal; $5 per additional signer. Identify: $4 per signer. Sign: $4 per transaction. On-demand witness: $10 each. Targeted at teams sending up to 25 transactions/month.

plans.name: Business Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually; price not published — contact sales. Includes API access, custom co-branding, Salesforce/eOriginal/Adobe eSign integrations, Proof Defend fraud monitoring. For teams scaling beyond 25 transactions/month.

plans.name: Business Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing — contact sales. Includes Command Center (SSO, SCIM), preferred Notarize Network access, enterprise notary management, dedicated Customer Success Manager.

plans.name: Real Estate Title Pro
plans.notes: Pay-per-meeting. Rates shown are for in-house notaries: seller-side/cash/HELOC closings $45/meeting; mortgage packages $90/meeting; ancillary docs $25/meeting. Meetings fulfilled by the Notarize Network bill at standard rates ($99 / $150 / $35 respectively). Identify $4/signer; Sign $4/transaction. Targeted at small title teams with in-house notaries.

plans.name: Real Estate Title Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually; price not published — contact sales. Includes ResWare and SoftPro 360 integrations, closing concierge team, templating services.

plans.name: Lender Premium
plans.notes: Custom pricing — contact sales. Unlimited seats, Notarize API access, Encompass and SimpleNexus integrations.

limits: Business Pro targeted at up to 25 transactions/month
keyFeatures: Large on-demand notary network
Multi-product platform: Notarize, Sign, Identify, Verify, Certify, Defend
NIST IAL2-certified identity verification (Kantara)
SOC 2, MISMO, WCAG AA, WebTrust audited
